policy_name: GLOBAL BANKING CORPORATION - DATA RETENTION & ARCHIVAL POLICY v2.4
description: Policy 'GLOBAL BANKING CORPORATION - DATA RETENTION & ARCHIVAL POLICY v2.4' defines compliance retention and archival thresholds for Transaction Data Archival Policy.
rule_summary: Policy 'GLOBAL BANKING CORPORATION - DATA RETENTION & ARCHIVAL POLICY v2.4' defines compliance retention and archival thresholds for Transaction Data Archival Policy.

requirements.description: Financial transaction records must be retained per regulatory lifecycle periods.
Independent verification and cryptographic SHA-256 validation required before source deletion.
Maker-checker dual-human authorization required before source database record cleanup.

rules.description: [source_transactions] Operation: ARCHIVE transaction records older than five years must be transferred to immutable archival storage.
[source_transactions] Operation: ARCHIVE Records must be retained for eight years prior to any final disposal.

exceptions.title: Exclusion (legal_hold)
exceptions.reason: Operation: EXCLUDE Condition: legal_hold equals true Records subject to an active legal hold are strictly exempt from archival or cleanup.
